name: TexteSEO
description: Piqueray TexteSEO, v2 (2026-09-07): anchored on the candidate set 2768:20428 (page 031, four variants Presentation=Mobile|Tablette|Desktop|Wide, cloned from the DS master 2108:3123 and reworked with the owner). MAJOR: the anchors leave the single COMPONENT master. What changes against 3.0.0: the viewport axis `presentation` (padding-inline 24/48/56/89 by mode, gap 32 everywhere), the title rides the DS H2 role (24/30 then 32/40 then 40/50, SemiBold — was 24/30 Regular), the paragraph rides the body role (16/24 Regular under 992, 18/27 Medium above — was 14/24 Regular) and becomes a governed rich-text prop `texte` (bold ranges kept), the sub-title rides the H4 role (20/25 then 24/30) and becomes the prop `sousTitre` bound to the new TEXT property `SousTitre`, and it wraps (FILL). The rows are ds.accordion-row 2.0.0 in Petit, unchanged. Named deviations against the dump are carried on each part's description.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Viewport presentation, mirroring the canvas axis Presentation of the candidate set. Default = mobile, the first variant (Figma's default) and the mobile-first base of the delivered CSS; in the delivered CSS the mode is selected by the viewport through the breakpoint tokens, never by a consumer.

props.name: titre
props.description: Section title, bound to the set's TEXT property « Titre ». Kept RICH (marks.strong) as in 3.0.0 so the writer may still bold a range; the candidate draws it UNIFORM SemiBold (dump: fontStyle SemiBold on the whole node, no bold segment) so the default carries no bold segment — 3.0.0's « showroom à Pepinster » in bold came from the old master, not from the candidate.

default.text: Visitez notre showroom à Pepinster ou contactez-nous

props.name: texte
props.description: The long paragraph, RICH: six bold ranges drawn on every variant of the candidate (owner rule 2026-09-02: a text with bold is rich). The candidate set exposes NO text property for it on purpose (owner decision 2026-09-02: a rich text is bound NONE, the canvas keeps its ranges by hand). 3.0.0 carried it as a static part text with no bold: it is now a governed prop so the Odoo writer edits it as rich text. The default is the candidate's own text, bold ranges as drawn — the spaces glued to the bold boundaries (« nos» + « portes de garage, motorisations » + «et» + « portes d'entrée») are the source's, reproduced as is.

default.text: Rien ne vaut le toucher et la vue pour choisir ses finitions. Notre
) vous permet de découvrir en taille réelle nos
. Vous pourrez y comparer les textures (Woodgrain, Silkgrain), les coloris et tester la robustesse des produits
. Nos conseillers sont à votre disposition pour étudier vos plans et vous orienter vers la meilleure solution technique et budgétaire.

props.name: sousTitre
props.description: Sub-title above the rows, bound to the TEXT property « SousTitre » added on the candidate set (source defect n°1 of the audit, fixed on the candidate: the master had no property and the 9 instances overrode the text raw). Plain text, no bold, no line break.

props.name: items
props.description: Les lignes d'accordéon. `etat` est observé par entrée sur le candidat (la 2e ligne est ouverte, les deux autres fermées) : le renseigner rend chaque ligne CONTRÔLÉE côté React — la géométrie est fidèle, mais une ligne ne se replie plus d'elle-même tant que le consommateur ne possède pas l'état (le canal `repeat` ne porte pas d'événement par entrée). Limite nommée, pas un oubli.

root.description: Section root, FILL width (the drawn widths 390/834/1200/1728 are witnesses, not tokens — the extraction proposed them as imported.texte-seo.root.width.*, dropped). Column in every variant (dump: VERTICAL, counter MIN — carried as align stretch since every child is FILL, same rendering); padding-inline bound space/24 · 48 · 56 · 89 by presentation, gap bound space/32 on all four variants (owner decision 2026-09-07: 32 everywhere, no mobile reference exists). No padding-block on the set (0). 3.0.0's declared align-self stretch is dropped: width fill carries it.

Titre.description: DEVIATION (named), same as 3.0.0: on the canvas this is the frame `h2` (row, FILL) holding the frame `Titre direct` (column, counter CENTER, gap space/8, FILL) holding the text `Titre` (FILL, HEIGHT auto) — two single-child wrappers flattened into this one text part with width fill (the gap has nothing to space; prior art: ds.presentation 4.0.0 dropped the same `Titre direct` frame). Rides the responsive text style H2 recognized by the extraction: size 24/24/32/40 and line-height 30/30/40/50 by viewport come from typography.h2.* (tokens/modes/viewport.*), weight SemiBold (dump: SemiBold on every variant), color color/noir-bleute bound. Heights measured on the candidate: 90 (3 lines) / 30 / 40 / 50.

p.description: Paragraph frame: column, FILL width, no padding, no gap (dump, all four variants).

Paragraphe.description: The long paragraph, FILL width, HEIGHT auto. The text node has NO Figma text style (the DS has no body style): it is bound directly to the body variables, which the extraction cannot see (dump v1.8 flattens text bindings) — it minted imported.texte-seo.p-paragraphe.font-size/line-height.<mode> (16/24 · 16/24 · 18/27 · 18/27) and a single font-weight 500. Renamed by hand on owner decision to the responsive body role: font-size typography.body.size, line-height typography.body.line-height, and the base weight typography.body.weight — which DOES vary by viewport (Regular under 992, Medium at Desktop/Wide), exactly what the candidate draws per range (Regular ×2 / Medium ×2, like ds.sav; the extraction's uniform 500 was wrong for Mobile/Tablette). Bold ranges via marks.strong = font.weight.bold. Color color/noir (#37373B) bound on the source — the only DS text in that color, kept on owner decision (audit defect n°4, not contested). No line break in the text: no white-space rule, like 3.0.0. letter-spacing 0 minted by the extraction (imported.texte-seo.p-paragraphe.letter-spacing) is the UA default: not carried, as in 3.0.0. Heights on the candidate: 312 (13 lines) / 144 (6) / 135 (5) / 81 (3).

h3.description: Sub-title frame: row, FILL width, no padding (dump). 3.0.0 carried no layout on it; the row + FILL come from the candidate.

SousTitre.description: Sub-title, FILL width so it WRAPS (audit defect n°3: the master's HUG sub-title overflowed under 1550; fixed on the candidate). Rides the responsive text style H4 recognized by the extraction: size 20/20/24/24 and line-height 25/25/30/30 by viewport from typography.h4.* (tokens/modes/viewport.*), weight Medium (dump: Medium on every variant — 3.0.0 carried « Titre 5 » SemiBold from the old master), color color/noir-bleute bound. Rendered as the Odoo/HTML h3 level of the section (semantic level, not the H4 text style).

accordion.description: Rows container: column, counter CENTER, gap 0, FILL width (dump, all four variants). The three rows are FILL too (342 / 738 / 1088 / 1550), heights on the candidate 40·168·40 / 40·96·40 / 43·105·43 / 43·105·43 — the rows' own geometry belongs to ds.accordion-row 2.0.0.

AccordionRow.description: Three adjacent instances of the candidate AccordionRow set (linked by componentSetKey 7b4cc8de…, the anchor of ds.accordion-row 2.0.0), Taille=Petit, Etat Ferme / Ouvert / Ferme — one item template repeated over `items`, the drawn siblings as the static sample.

sample.contenu: Pour une simple visite découverte, le showroom est ouvert aux horaires indiqués. Pour une étude approfondie de projet avec un conseiller, la prise de rendez-vous est conseillée.
